classes.MU=1: T plus endpoints reconstruct exactly one raw history
classes.MU>1: information-collapse ambiguity among still-distinct native histories

finiteness_theorem.proof: Every realizing history has exactly N_T transitions and N_T+1 packet occurrences. Every occurrence lies in V=ACTIVE(T) union {s,t}, a finite set. Therefore F(T;s,t) is a subset of V^(N_T+1), so MU<=|V|^(N_T+1).
finiteness_theorem.statement: For finite-support T with finite N_T, MU(T;s,t) is a finite nonnegative integer.
